detail.longDescription: Introducing Self-Managed Keeper, a self-hosted, container-based deployment of KeeperPAM that provides credential, secrets and privileged access management within owned and operated infrastructure, including on-premises data centers, private clouds and fully air-gapped networks. - Designed for isolated OT, IT and defense environments - Operates without connectivity to Keeper's cloud service - Organizations maintain their own data boundary - Access credentials and privileged sessions during outages # KeeperSecurity # Cybersecurity # SelfHosted # SelfHostedTools # IdentitySecurity
